chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and his fiancée Lu Qian visit a property on Lanxie Road, located conveniently below his former residence. During the visit, they encounter a noblewoman who recognizes Shen Feizhi and expresses disapproval of Lu Qian, comparing her unfavorably to Gu Suizhou. Shen Feizhi manages to appease the woman with a calculated display of politeness. Later, they meet with Lu Fan, a reclusive and traumatized designer, to discuss renovations. Shen Feizhi uses his connection to the Elder Master Shen to coerce Lu Fan into revealing information about a past trauma involving the Shen family, suggesting a deeper, darker history behind the family's influence.

new_characters.name: Lu Fan
new_characters.description: A gaunt, dispirited, and traumatized elderly man who retired from design work due to a past incident involving the Shen family.

new_characters.name: Elder Master Shen
new_characters.description: Shen Feizhi's grandfather, a powerful figure who appears to have a history of intimidating or traumatizing those around him, including Lu Fan.

new_locations.name: Lanxie Road
new_locations.description: An exclusive, high-end residential area where properties are in high demand among the wealthy elite.

new_locations.name: Apartment 102, Building 6
new_locations.description: The specific unit Shen Feizhi purchased, located at the intersection of Street 2023 and Lanxie Road.

ambiguous.question: Shen Feizhi calls the noblewoman 'Big Sister' to manipulate her. Should this be translated as a literal familial term or a social honorific?
